title: MCP query_dataset returns one more drillRawRows entry than rows when it truncates at the caller limit
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czj9tecb4nj5MfUyYk

QA-source: #32940 · ai.mcp-dataset-tools · observed beside the clauses

Found by an off-clause probe of the 18.4.0 release acceptance (wave anchor #32908) at `main` @ `5fb79bc0`. Full evidence chain: QA run #32940, P-1, and its R4 comment.

## What happens

When MCP `query_dataset` truncates its answer at the caller's `limit`, `drillRawRows` carries **one more entry than `rows`**, so the index-aligned drill sidecar no longer lines up with the rows a client shows.

## Reproduction

MCP `query_dataset {datasetName: "showcase_invoice_metrics", selection: {measures: ["invoice_count"], dimensions: ["status"], limit: 1}}` on a stock showcase boot, as admin:
- **Expected** `rows` 1, `drillRawRows` 1, `truncated: true`.
- **Actual** `rows` 1, `drillRawRows` 2 (`[{status: draft}, {status: paid}]`), `truncated: true`.
- With `limit: 2`: rows 2, drillRawRows 3.

Reproduced twice. Not a disclosure: the caller may query that group anyway.

## Mechanism (read at 5fb79bc0)

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts`: the tool asks the service for `cap + 1` rows so `truncated` is a fact, slices `rows` to `cap`, then spreads `...rest` from the answer untrimmed. Every index-aligned sidecar in `rest` (`drillRawRows`, and any sibling the answer carries) keeps the probe row.
